slots.title: Market floor: the bell
slots.brief: A classic exchange opening bell: polished brass bell on a small dark wooden plinth with a hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) enamel band and a diamond plate on the front, mid-ring, with flat curved motion arcs on both sides and a few tiny sparkles. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading, one strong highlight.
slots.notes: Replaces a fake 'BELL' talent placeholder. Rendered at 92px next to the next-tick countdown, so keep it bold and simple. Transparent background.

slots.title: HoloNews: story without a picture
slots.brief: The HoloNews stand-in picture: a stack of freshly printed newspapers on a dark desk, front pages covered in blank grey headline bars and photo boxes (no readable text), a slim ticker ribbon curling across them in hololive blue (#3fb8f5), a press microphone leaning on the stack. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), flat shapes, halftone shading, cool blue key light from the top right.
slots.notes: Used when a HoloNews story has no thumbnail and no talent to show. Shown both as the 16:9 lead image (~640px) and as a tiny ~96px square-ish crop, so keep the main shape centred. No text.

slots.title: Articles: player story without a picture
slots.brief: A player's writing desk at night: a laptop open to a blank editor glowing blue, sticky notes doodled with up and down arrows, a mug with a small diamond logo, a glowstick being used as a pen, a mini ticker screen in the corner. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), hololive blue (#3fb8f5) screen light, flat shapes with halftone shading, cosy.
slots.notes: Used when a player-written article has no image and no talent tag. Same crops as market.news-fallback (16:9 lead and ~120px row thumb). No readable text.

slots.title: Profile: banner backdrop
slots.brief: A wide, low-contrast panorama of the trading floor at night from a balcony: rows of desks with glowing monitors, a long curved ticker board along the far wall, soft volumetric light shafts. Mostly deep ink (#0a0c11) with hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) points of light; everything slightly out of focus so it reads as texture. The left half and the bottom third are the calmest parts.
slots.notes: Behind every profile banner. The UI lays the player's colour and a dark bottom fade on top, and the oshi's key art sits in the right third, so keep detail subtle and mid-frame. Cropped to ~250px tall at any width (object-position center).

slots.title: Leaderboard: podium stage
slots.brief: A dark stage seen head-on with three tall spotlight beams coming down (the centre one brightest), light haze, a scatter of hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) and white confetti and a few falling order slips, a low glowing ticker strip along the stage lip. Dark ink (#0a0c11) everywhere else. Flat shapes with halftone in the beams.
slots.notes: Behind the three podium steps; avatars, names and numbers sit on top, so beams should land at roughly 17%, 50% and 83% across and stay soft. On phones the steps stack and the image is cropped to the centre.

slots.title: Livestreams: nobody's live
slots.brief: An empty streaming setup after hours: a gaming chair turned slightly away, a ring light switched off, a monitor showing a blank screen with a tiny sleeping crescent moon, a headset hung on the chair, cables on the floor. Muted blues and greys with one soft hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) standby glow. Flat shapes, halftone shading.
slots.notes: Shown above 'Nobody's live right now', ~220px wide, centred. Transparent background. No logos or brand marks on the gear.

slots.title: Share image: stock page plate
slots.brief: The background plate for per-stock share cards: dark ink (#0a0c11) with a large faint candlestick chart climbing left to right in hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) halftone, a thin glowing baseline and a subtle grid. The right 45% is left empty and soft (the talent's key art is composited there) and the top-left block is kept clear for the ticker, name and price.
slots.notes: A template, not a finished card. Not wired yet: hook it in app/stocks/[stockName]/opengraph-image.tsx (next/og ImageResponse) compositing this plate, the talent key art (talent set) and the live symbol/price. No text in the plate.
